fields.cannotEstablish: that the bundle was produced by any particular tool
that the signing material belongs to the expected party
that any certificate is signed by a trusted CA
fields.type: list of canonical base64 DER certificates

fields.cannotEstablish: that the certificate was not revoked after issue
that the issuer actually issued this certificate until cert_verify accepts the path
that the workload actually controls the identity until cert_verify accepts the path
that the payload is true, only that its bytes are the artefact's bytes
that the signature verifies without a signature verifier
fields.type: canonical base64 signature over the DSSE PAE

fields.cannotEstablish: that the log is honest or append-only
that the entry body is the envelope in this bundle
that the log assigned the index or time
that the proof is valid without the log public key
fields.type: one of the two, structurally valid

fields.cannotEstablish: that the timestamp authority signed it without the TSA root

freshness.cannotCheckOffline: whether the log's integratedTime is earlier than a later revocation
freshness.integratedTime: from the tlog entry, used to place the certificate validity window
freshness.liveClock: not consulted; a bundle is judged at its integratedTime, not at the validator's clock
freshness.timestamp: required by this profile; its own verification is NOT_RUN without a TSA root

nonClaims: BUNDLE_VERIFIED_OFFLINE is not a judgement that the log or the CA is trustworthy
BUNDLE_VERIFIED_OFFLINE does not mean the payload is true
no bundle exists in this tree, so no real bundle is verified
profile.refusedVersionBehaviour: v0.1 and v0.2 use a different shape and a versioned media type; they are refused with SB_REFUSED_VERSION rather than read with v0.3 names

caRoot.cannotCheckOffline: revocation (OCSP/CRL), name constraints across a real path, and whether the CA is trustworthy
caRoot.suppliedBy: policy.caRoots, verified by the caller's cert_verify

expectedIssuerAndIdentity.cannotCheckOffline: that the expected identity is the one the policy writer intended

logPublicKey.cannotCheckOffline: whether the log is append-only, honest or globally consistent
logPublicKey.suppliedBy: policy.logKey, verified by the caller's log_verify

timestampAuthorityRoot.cannotCheckOffline: whether the TSA's clock was correct at signing time
timestampAuthorityRoot.suppliedBy: policy.timestampRoots, verified by the caller's timestamp_verify
